name: blobatar-cli
description: Deterministic geometric blobatars from any string, in your terminal.
//engines: The published artifact runs under plain node — npx is where the non-JS-project audience lives — so src/ uses no Bun-only APIs. A deliberate, documented exception to the repo's Bun-first preference; bun and bunx work too.

scripts.check: bun test && bun run build && bun run smoke

//dependencies: Exactly these three at runtime: render-core is private and gets inlined into dist by the build. resvg-js ships per-platform napi prebuilds as optionalDependencies with no postinstall. blobatar is a real semver range rather than workspace:* — bun still links the workspace member because it satisfies the range, while a tarball built by any tool (npm pack included, which does not rewrite the workspace protocol) stays installable. blobatar-v1 aliases the frozen v1 major so --gen 1 renders it, the same pairing apps/api uses.
